```{r, echo=FALSE}
source("/novo/users/czjs/doctoral_work/ggplate_functions/plate_plot.R")

load("/novo/users/czjs/doctoral_work/ggplate_functions/viridis_colours.rda")


```

#### **Read & Process data** {.tabset}

**Requires data in tidy format:** *nX Screen, nX 96w per screen, nX controls, nX Unique genes per screen*

```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE}


# loop for plates

what_to_plot <- c("cells", "z_score_cells", "log_2_cells")[1]

temp <- c()
temp_2 <- c()
plates_cleaned <- c()
temp_plot <- c()
list_of_plates <- "AAVS1_nuclei_count.txt"

for (i in 1:length(list_of_plates)) {
  #print(list_of_plates[i])
  
  row_alphabet <- c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "H")
  
  temp <- fread(list_of_plates[i], skip = 8)
  print(temp)
  
  temp_2 <- temp %>%
    dplyr::select(c("Row", "Column", "Nuclei - Number of Objects")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(cells = `Nuclei - Number of Objects`)
  
  temp_2 <- temp_2[!temp_2$Column %in% c(1,12)]

  print(temp_2)
  
  for (j in 1:8) {
    temp_2$Row[temp_2$Row == j] <- row_alphabet[j]
  }
  
  plates_cleaned[[i]] <- temp_2 %>%
    dplyr::mutate( cells = cells,
                   well = paste0(Row, Column),
                   .keep = "none") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(z_score_cells = (cells - mean(cells)/sd(cells)),
                  log_2_cells = log2(cells)
    )
  
  temp_plot <- plate_plot(
    data = plates_cleaned[[i]],
    position = well,
    value = log_2_cells, # or z_score_cells, or log_2_cells
    plate_size = 96,
    plate_type = "round",
    colour = viridis_colours
  )
  
  
  show(temp_plot)
  
  
  
}



```


**Data processing for visualisation & analysis:**

-   Generating (Partial) pID = Row, Column; (Unique) ID = Plate, Row, Column, Position

```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
plate_names <- c("plate_1", "plate_2", "plate_3")
names(plates_cleaned) <- plate_names

combined_df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(plates_cleaned), function(name) {
  df <- plates_cleaned[[name]]
  df$Plate <- name
  df
}))

data_all <- combined_df %>% 
    dplyr::select(-z_score_cells, -log_2_cells) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(pID = well,
                  Nuclei = cells) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(Row = str_extract(pID, "[A-Za-z]+")) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(Column = str_extract(pID, "[0-9]+")) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(Column = as.numeric(Column)) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(Position = ifelse(Row %in% c("A", "H") | Column %in% c(1, 12), "edge", "non-edge"))

#Generating Unique IDs
data_all %<>% 
  dplyr::mutate(ID=paste(Plate, Row, Column, Position, sep = "_"))

```




-   Generating Log2 values (for each plate based on nuclei number and AdipoRED Area per Cell)

```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
 
#Generating Log2 values
data_all %<>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Log2_Nuclei=log2(data_all$Nuclei))
```

-   Generating Z Score (for each plate based on nuclei number and AdipoRED Area per Cell)

```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

#Creating Z score by plate
data_all %<>% 
  dplyr::group_by(Plate) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Nuclei_z_score = Nuclei - mean(Nuclei)/sd(Nuclei))

```

-   Average nuclei count

```{r}


average_plate <- data_all %>% 
    group_by(pID) %>% 
    dplyr::transmute(average_nuclei_log2 = mean(Log2_Nuclei)) %>% 
    unique()


plate_plot(
  data = average_plate,
  position = pID,
  value = average_nuclei_log2,
  plate_size = 96,
  plate_type = "round",
  colour = viridis_colours
)

```




-   Generating summary data - mean, SD (based on pID)

```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

#Generating summary data (average, SD & CV) by position (pID) 
data_all_sum_Nuclei = data_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(pID, Row, Column, Position) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Nuclei_avg= mean(Log2_Nuclei),
                   Nuclei_sd = sd(Log2_Nuclei),
                   Nuclei_cv = 100 * sd(Log2_Nuclei) / mean(Log2_Nuclei),
                   Nuclei_z_mean = mean(Nuclei_z_score))

```

#### **Visualising Raw data** {.tabset}

##### Cell numbers

```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
data_all %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Column, y=Nuclei, color=Position, groups=Row)) +
  geom_line(colour="grey") +
  #geom_line(aes(colour=Row)) +
  geom_point(size=2, alpha=0.5) +
  theme_pubr() +
  facet_wrap(~as.character(Plate)) + 
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  ggtitle("Raw data_all Cell numbers (Nuclei count) aggregated by well") +
  xlab("Column") +ylab("Nuclei numbers") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=1:12)
  
```

#### **Visualise aggregated CV values** {.tabset}

##### %CV Cell numbers

```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
data_all_sum_Nuclei %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Column, y=Nuclei_cv, color=Position, groups=Row)) +
  geom_line(colour="grey") +
  #geom_line(aes(colour=Row)) +
  geom_point(size=3, alpha=0.5) +
  theme_pubr() +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = ifelse(Nuclei_cv > 10, pID, "")), 
                  color = "red", nudge_y = 2, size = 4) +
  ggtitle("CV for Cell Numbers") +
  xlab("Column") +ylab("% CV") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=1:12)
```

#### **Visualise Raw Data spatially** (by Plate) {.tabset}

##### Raw Data - Cell numbers

```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
data_all$Plate <- as.factor(data_all$Plate)
data_all$Row <- as.factor(data_all$Row)

data_all %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=ordered(Column), y=fct_rev(as.factor(Row)), fill=Nuclei,
             label=round(Nuclei,0))) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(size=2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_b() +
  xlab("Column") +ylab("Row") +
  labs(title = "Heatmap for individual plates Raw_data - Cell Numbers", 
       fill = "Nuclei Numbers") +
  facet_grid(~Plate) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_pubr()
```

##### Log2 - Cell numbers

```{r, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
Log2_nuclei_means <- data_all %>% 
  group_by(data_all$Position) %>% 
  summarise(m = mean(Log2_Nuclei))

data_all %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=Log2_Nuclei, fill=Position, colour=Position)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = unlist(Log2_nuclei_means[1,2]), color = "red", linetype = "dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = unlist(Log2_nuclei_means[2,2]), color = "blue", linetype = "dashed")+
  theme_pubr() +
  labs(title = "Summary data - Log2 Cell Numbers", x = "Log2 Nuclei Numbers", y = "Density")

```
